title: Bye Bye Bilbo
statementMd:
Bilbo Baggins is finally leaving the Shire! To celebrate his departure, Gandalf plans to set up a spectacular display of fireworks across the land.

The Shire has $n$ hobbit holes numbered $1$ to $n$, each of which is occupied by exactly one hobbit. Every hole $i \gt 1$ is connected by a lane directly to a unique hole $p_i$, with $p_i \lt i$, so that following the lanes always leads towards hole $1$, the town.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/415bf475600885a83677994f1bca61d0fd55a966.png)Illustration of the first sample.

Gandalf must place fireworks at a minimum number of hobbit holes so that every hobbit can see at least one firework. The fireworks have a visibility range $k$. A hobbit at hole $i$ can see a firework placed at hole $j$ if it is placed at their own hole, or if $j$ lies on the path from hole $i$ to the town and the number of lanes between $i$ and $j$ is strictly less than $k$.

## Input

The input consists of:

- One line with two integers $n$ and $k$ ($2 \leq n \leq 10^5$, $1 \le k \le n$), the number of hobbit holes and the firework range.
- One line with $n-1$ integers $p_2, p_3, \ldots, p_n$ ($1 \le p_i \leq i-1$), where $p_i$ is the next hole reached when going from hole $i$ toward the town.

## Output

Output one integer $m$, the minimum number of hobbit holes where a firework must be placed, followed by $m$ distinct integers, the indices of those holes.

If there are multiple ways to place the fireworks using the minimum number of holes, you may output any one of them.

## Note

In the first sample, a firework at hole $1$, i.e. the town, can only be seen by the hobbits at holes $1$, $2$, $3$, and $4$. A second firework at hole $5$ can only be seen by the hobbit at hole $5$.

In the second sample, a firework at hole $1$ can only be seen by the hobbits at holes $1$, $2$, and $3$. A second firework at hole $3$ can only be seen by the hobbits at holes $3$, $4$, $5$, and $6$. So every hobbit can see at least one firework.
statementZhMd:
比尔博·巴金斯终于要离开夏尔了！为了庆祝他的离去，甘道夫计划在这片土地上安排一场壮观的烟花表演。

夏尔有 $n$ 个霍比特人洞穴，编号为 $1$ 到 $n$，每个洞穴里恰好住着一名霍比特人。对于每个洞穴 $i \gt 1$，都有一条小路将它与唯一的洞穴 $p_i$ 直接相连，其中 $p_i \lt i$，因此沿着这些小路前进，总能到达作为城镇的洞穴 $1$。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/415bf475600885a83677994f1bca61d0fd55a966.png)第一个样例的示意图。

甘道夫需要在尽可能少的霍比特人洞穴处放置烟花，使每名霍比特人都能看到至少一处烟花。烟花的可见范围为 $k$。住在洞穴 $i$ 的霍比特人能够看到放置在洞穴 $j$ 处的烟花，当且仅当烟花就放在他自己的洞穴处，或者 $j$ 位于从洞穴 $i$ 到城镇的路径上，且 $i$ 与 $j$ 之间的小路数量严格小于 $k$。

## 输入格式

输入包括：

- 一行，包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $k$（$2 \leq n \leq 10^5$, $1 \le k \le n$），分别表示霍比特人洞穴的数量和烟花的可见范围。
- 一行，包含 $n-1$ 个整数 $p_2, p_3, \ldots, p_n$（$1 \le p_i \leq i-1$），其中 $p_i$ 表示从洞穴 $i$ 朝城镇方向前进时到达的下一个洞穴。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数 $m$，表示需要放置烟花的霍比特人洞穴的最少数量，随后输出 $m$ 个互不相同的整数，表示这些洞穴的编号。

如果有多种使用最少数量洞穴的烟花放置方案，可以输出其中任意一种。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，放置在洞穴 $1$（即城镇）处的烟花只有住在洞穴 $1$、$2$、$3$ 和 $4$ 的霍比特人能够看到。放置在洞穴 $5$ 处的第二处烟花只有住在洞穴 $5$ 的霍比特人能够看到。

在第二个样例中，放置在洞穴 $1$ 处的烟花只有住在洞穴 $1$、$2$ 和 $3$ 的霍比特人能够看到。放置在洞穴 $3$ 处的第二处烟花只有住在洞穴 $3$、$4$、$5$ 和 $6$ 的霍比特人能够看到。因此，每名霍比特人都能看到至少一处烟花。
